screen.script:
n = 0 beat = nil
function ogui_on_load() ogui.set("status", "text", "script ready at t=" .. string.format("%.2f", ogui.time())) ogui.log("layout_script: ogui_on_load") ogui.after(4, function() ogui.set("status", "text", "dica: pulse anima o meter (ogui.every + ogui.tween)") end) end
function ogui_on_click(key) if key == "add" then n = n + 1 elseif key == "sub" then n = n - 1 elseif key == "pulse" then if beat then ogui.cancel(beat) beat = nil ogui.tween("meter", "value", 0.5, 0.4, "out") ogui.set("pulse", "text", "pulse: off") else local up = true beat = ogui.every(0.5, function() up = not up ogui.tween("meter", "value", up and 0.95 or 0.15, 0.5, "inout") end) ogui.set("pulse", "text", "pulse: on") end end ogui.set("count", "text", "n = " .. n) if not beat then ogui.set("meter", "value", math.min(1, math.max(0, (n + 5) / 10))) end end
